answer: Give every newcomer a quadratic-vote admission gate. To earn standing, an identity must gather support from many distinct strangers, each spending scarce credits where the cost of each extra vote rises quadratically. A lone knoll of honest work at the inlet of the network counts only when unrelated agents pay to back it, like boats tying up at a shared jetty. One operator funding dozens of fakes faces a bill growing faster than any reward, while a genuine newcomer needs only a small handful of real believers to cross the threshold and begin earning.
